title: Formal Substrate Change Record
description: The release classification one change carries (CAS-ADR-008). Every change that touches the published contract adds one record as a YAML file under docs/fs/changes/unreleased/. A record carries no version number: the release step assigns every unreleased record to the release that publishes it, folding the records into the manifest's revision_history and deleting the files, so concurrent changes add independent files rather than contending for the next number. The file name is a short kebab-case slug describing the change; it is not read.

classification.description: Whether the change is released as a patch, which needs no versioning act, or requires a new minor release because it crosses one of the three minor boundaries. A contract comparison finding a minor-level change refuses a patch classification unless detector_override records why.

category.description: The minor boundaries the change crosses; required for a minor and absent for a patch. More than one applies where several do.

items.description: capability: a caller can do something it could not do before. caller-adaptation: a caller must change what it does, or its current calls change meaning. operator-adaptation: someone running CAS must act beyond deploying the new build.

summary.description: What changed and why, for maintainers: the substrate artifacts touched and the shape of the change. Becomes the change's entry in the release's revision history.

for_callers.description: Release-note text a caller or operator needs, in one or two sentences. Required and non-empty for a minor; empty or omitted for a pure patch.

detector_override.description: The project owner's explicit downgrade of the contract comparison's findings for this change, recorded in the change for review. It covers the change's findings as a whole. Present only when the comparison finds a minor-level change that the owner has judged a patch, such as declaring behaviour the server already had; the gate warns when no finding remains to override.

reason.description: Why the finding asks nothing new of callers, stated so a reviewer can check it.
